0dbf97724b.q: How many days did the Prophet ﷺ spend in iʿtikaf in Ramadan of the year he died?
0dbf97724b.e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to spend ten days in iʿtikaf every Ramadan; in the year he died he spent twenty.

4e6d46ba15.q: How many times was the Qurʾan reviewed with the Prophet ﷺ in Ramadan of the year he died?
4e6d46ba15.e: The Qurʾan was reviewed with him every Ramadan; in the year he died it was reviewed with him twice.

fe46be2449.q: According to Ibn Ishaq, how did the Prophet's ﷺ final illness begin?
c: He went out to Baqiʿ al-Gharqad in the depth of the night and prayed for forgiveness for them
He led the people in prayer sitting
He gave a sermon from the pulpit
fe46be2449.e: The first sign of it for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was that he went out to Baqiʿ al-Gharqad in the depth of the night and asked forgiveness for them.

29574245a0.q: Whom did the Prophet ﷺ dispatch after returning from the Farewell Hajj, just as his illness began?
29574245a0.e: Ibn Ishaq said: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ returned from the Farewell Hajj … and dispatched Usama ibn Zayd; while the people were at that, his illness began.

69f9ba6921.q: Who was the first-appointed commander at the Battle of Muʾta?
69f9ba6921.e: Zayd ibn Haritha was the first commander at Muʾta, then Jaʿfar after him, then ʿAbd Allah ibn Rawaha.

30d24ff82f.q: What did ʿAʾisha say about Zayd ibn Haritha and the expeditions?
c: The Prophet ﷺ never sent him on an expedition without making him its commander
He was in charge of the spoils
30d24ff82f.e: ʿAʾisha said: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ never sent Zayd ibn Haritha on an expedition without making him commander, and had he outlived him he would have appointed him successor.

b10dc9f8ae.q: In which year was Zayd ibn Haritha killed at Muʾta?
c: The year 8, months before the Conquest
b10dc9f8ae.e: Zayd ibn Haritha was killed at Muʾta in Jumada of the year 8 AH, months before the Conquest.

7ac40e2d88.q: What name did the Prophet ﷺ give the freedman who narrated “The caliphate in my Umma is thirty years”?
7ac40e2d88.e: The freedman of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “I will not tell you [my name]; the Messenger of Allah named me Safina.”

5148447562.q: Who freed Safina on condition that he serve the Prophet ﷺ for as long as he lived?
5148447562.e: Safina was the freedman of Umm Salama; she freed him on condition that he serve the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for as long as he lived.

7a661f2735.q: In Safina's hadith, how long is the caliphate in the Prophet's ﷺ Umma before it becomes kingship?
7a661f2735.e: Safina said: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The caliphate in my Umma is thirty years, then kingship after that.”

624c7f8b76.q: At which spring did the Prophet ﷺ say, “Whoever reaches it, let him not touch its water until I come”?
624c7f8b76.e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Tomorrow, if Allah wills, you will come to the spring of Tabuk … whoever reaches it, let him not touch its water until I come.”

d7a161095b.q: What did the Prophet ﷺ say to Muʿadh after the spring of Tabuk flowed with abundant water?
c: “If you live long, you may soon see this place filled with gardens”
“You will be governor of this valley”
d7a161095b.e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Muʿadh, if you live long you may soon see this place filled with gardens.” Narrated by Muslim.

098f351050.q: What did the Prophet ﷺ do with the little water collected from the spring of Tabuk?
c: He washed his face and hands in it, then poured it back, and the spring flowed abundantly
He shared it among the army
He poured it on the ground
098f351050.e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ washed his face and hands in it and poured it back; the spring flowed with abundant water and the people drew from it.

be60d92085.q: What did the Prophet ﷺ lean his back against when he addressed the people in the year of Tabuk?
be60d92085.e: Abu Saʿid al-Khudri said: in the year of Tabuk the Messenger of Allah ﷺ addressed the people leaning his back against a palm tree.

1a0d880d91.q: With what words did the Prophet ﷺ comfort the Ansar after sharing out the spoils of Hawazin?
c: “Are you not content that people go off with wealth while you go off with the Messenger of Allah?”
“I will give you double what I gave them”
1a0d880d91.e: He ﷺ said: “Are you not content that people go off with wealth while you go off with the Messenger of Allah to your homes?” They said: “We are content.”

f89988bc1d.q: What did some of the Ansar say when the Prophet ﷺ gave men of Quraysh from the wealth of Hawazin?
c: “He gives Quraysh and leaves us, while our swords drip with their blood”
f89988bc1d.e: Some of the Ansar said: “May Allah forgive the Messenger of Allah ﷺ - he gives Quraysh and leaves us, while our swords drip with their blood.”

c983a87255.q: How many Muslims were there on the day of Hawazin, as Ibn Kathir corrects it?
c983a87255.e: Ibn Kathir said: it is odd that he says they were six thousand on the day of Hawazin; they were twelve thousand.

d578f7ee68.q: How long did the Muslims besiege Taʾif, as Ibn Kathir says?
c: Close to a month, but under twenty nights
d578f7ee68.e: Ibn Kathir said: his saying that they besieged Taʾif forty nights is odd; they besieged it for close to a month, under twenty nights.

ac2eb37fdc.q: How many camels did the Prophet ﷺ give some men from the wealth of Hawazin?
ac2eb37fdc.e: Anas said: the Prophet ﷺ began giving men a hundred camels each.

53faf7e77d.q: In which year and month was the Make-up ʿUmra (ʿUmrat al-Qadaʾ)?
53faf7e77d.e: Ibn Kathir said: the Make-up ʿUmra was in the year 7, in Dhu al-Qaʿda.

b806f00120.q: What did the polytheists say of the Muslims arriving in Makkah for the Make-up ʿUmra, so that the Prophet ﷺ told them to walk briskly (raml)?
c: “A party is coming to you weakened by the fever of Yathrib”
b806f00120.e: The polytheists said: “A party is coming to you weakened by the fever of Yathrib,” so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ told them to walk briskly.

9c2c173f7d.q: What did the Prophet ﷺ tell his Companions when the fever of Madinah struck them and they prayed sitting?
c: “The prayer of one sitting is half the prayer of one standing”
9c2c173f7d.e: He ﷺ said: “Know that the prayer of one sitting is half the prayer of one standing,” so the Muslims strained to stand, seeking the reward.

9a71c9e035.q: What did the Prophet ﷺ say when he struck the rock at the Trench and a third of it broke off?
c: “Allahu akbar - the palaces of Syria, by the Lord of the Kaʿba!”
“Allahu akbar - the help of Allah has come!”
9a71c9e035.e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ struck the rock, a third of it broke off, and he said: “Allahu akbar - the palaces of Syria, by the Lord of the Kaʿba!”

d20d7bbce1.q: With whom was the rock at the Trench that had defeated him, before the Prophet ﷺ struck it?
d20d7bbce1.e: He ﷺ said: “Take us to Salman,” and there was a rock before him that had defeated him; he said: “Let me be the first to strike it.”

b9a5087022.q: What nickname did Caliph Abu Jaʿfar al-Mansur get for holding his officials to account down to the daniq (a tiny coin)?
b9a5087022.e: Al-Mansur was extremely careful and tight-fisted; he was nicknamed Abu al-Dawaniq for holding officials and craftsmen to account down to the daniq and the grain.

6e4f084974.q: Which imam did al-Mansur flog for refusing a judgeship, then imprison until he died days later?
6e4f084974.e: Al-Suyuti said: he is the one who flogged Abu Hanifa, may Allah have mercy on him, over the judgeship, then imprisoned him, and he died days later.

9c750382e9.q: Who was the mother of Caliph Abu Jaʿfar al-Mansur?
9c750382e9.e: Al-Mansur Abu Jaʿfar ʿAbd Allah ibn Muhammad; his mother was Salama the Berber, a concubine-mother.

f72ea36603.q: What was the Abbasid al-Mahdi the first to order, in answering the heretics (zanadiqa)?
c: The writing of books of debate refuting them
The building of the House of Wisdom
f72ea36603.e: Al-Mahdi pursued the heretics, and he was the first to order books of debate written to refute the heretics and atheists.

132c572cf1.e: The caliphate of al-Mahdi: Abu ʿAbd Allah Muhammad, son of al-Mansur.

cc7649123c.q: What was the name of Caliph al-Hadi's mother?
cc7649123c.e: Al-Hadi Musa ibn al-Mahdi; his mother was a Berber concubine-mother named al-Khayzuran.

42e9c96db1.q: Why was Caliph al-Hadi called “Musa, close it” (Musa atbiq)?
c: His upper lip drew back, so he was reminded to close his lips
He closed in on his enemies
42e9c96db1.e: He was called “Musa, close it” because his upper lip drew back, and his servant would say “Musa, close it,” and he would close his lips.

ea35b5526c.q: What was the first thing al-Amin ordered, the day after his accession?
c: A ground built for playing ball
ea35b5526c.e: As soon as al-Amin received the pledge, he ordered on the second day a ground built beside al-Mansur's palace for playing ball.

2aa5e32312.q: Who is said to have urged al-Amin to depose his brother al-Maʾmun?
2aa5e32312.e: It is said that al-Fadl ibn al-Rabiʿ knew that if the caliphate passed to al-Maʾmun he would not spare him, so he urged al-Amin against him.

54cfab1dc2.q: What led al-Maʾmun to the doctrine that the Qurʾan is created, according to al-Suyuti?
c: His devotion to philosophy and the sciences of the ancients
Keeping company with the Muʿtazila as a child
54cfab1dc2.e: When al-Maʾmun grew up he devoted himself to philosophy and the sciences of the ancients and mastered them, and that led him to the doctrine that the Qurʾan is created.

34695af580.q: What was the name of al-Maʾmun's mother, who died giving birth to him?
34695af580.e: Al-Maʾmun ʿAbd Allah ibn al-Rashid; his mother was a concubine-mother named Marajil, who died in childbirth with him.

9f32859a40.q: On which night was al-Maʾmun born?
c: The night al-Hadi died and his father al-Rashid became caliph
9f32859a40.e: Al-Maʾmun was born on Friday night in mid-Rabiʿ al-Awwal 170 AH - the night al-Hadi died and his father became caliph.

7cf4fe62eb.q: How did al-Suyuti describe Caliph al-Muʿtasim in learning?
7cf4fe62eb.e: Al-Muʿtasim was brave, strong and ambitious, but devoid of learning; he wrote and read poorly.

b08c144a1a.q: What was the name of Caliph al-Muʿtasim bi-llah's mother?
b08c144a1a.e: Al-Muʿtasim's mother was a concubine-mother born in Kufa named Marida, the most favoured of women with al-Rashid.

a6e2d86d5a.q: Which scholar of hadith was killed in al-Wathiq's caliphate during the trial over the created Qurʾan?
a6e2d86d5a.e: In 231 AH Ahmad ibn Nasr al-Khuzaʿi was killed; he was a man of hadith who commanded the good.

ff5bcfea65.q: Whom did al-Wathiq make his deputy over the sultanate, dressing him in two jewelled sashes and a crown?
ff5bcfea65.e: In 228 AH al-Wathiq made Ashnas the Turk his deputy over the sultanate and dressed him in two jewelled sashes and a jewelled crown.

b9cce97a3b.q: After whom did al-Muʿtadid bi-llah receive the pledge as caliph in 279 AH?
b9cce97a3b.e: Al-Muʿtadid received the pledge in Rajab 279 AH after his uncle al-Muʿtamid.

50d46b093f.q: How did al-Suyuti describe al-Muʿtadid's courage?
c: He would face a lion alone
He always fought in the front rank
50d46b093f.e: Al-Muʿtadid was a brave, awe-inspiring king, and he would face a lion alone out of courage.

9112b43f0d.q: Who was the last Abbasid caliph in Iraq?
9112b43f0d.e: Al-Mustaʿsim bi-llah Abu Ahmad ʿAbd Allah ibn al-Mustansir, the last of the caliphs in Iraq.

43c9419932.q: When did Muʿawiya ibn Abi Sufyan and his father become Muslim?
c: On the day Makkah was conquered
43c9419932.e: Muʿawiya and his father became Muslim on the day Makkah was conquered; he was present at Hunayn and was one of the scribes of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.

cc83f9a027.q: What service did Muʿawiya, may Allah be pleased with him, perform for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?
c: He was one of his scribes
cc83f9a027.e: Al-Suyuti said: he was one of the scribes of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.

87641e6398.q: What was the kunya of Muʿawiya ibn Abi Sufyan?
87641e6398.e: Muʿawiya ibn Abi Sufyan Sakhr ibn Harb the Umayyad, Abu ʿAbd al-Rahman.

967790ffb7.q: How many hadiths are narrated from Muʿawiya from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, as al-Suyuti mentions?
967790ffb7.e: One hundred and sixty-three hadiths are narrated from Muʿawiya from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.

808e1c30dc.q: Who was the mother of ʿAbd Allah ibn al-Zubayr?
808e1c30dc.e: ʿAbd Allah ibn al-Zubayr's mother was Asmaʾ bint Abi Bakr al-Siddiq, and his father's mother was Safiyya, aunt of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.

a62dcfd0ad.q: Why did the Muslims rejoice so greatly at the birth of ʿAbd Allah ibn al-Zubayr?
c: Because the Jews had been saying: “We have bewitched them, no child will be born to them”
Because he was the Prophet's ﷺ first grandchild
Because he was born on the day of Badr
Because he was born in the Kaʿba
a62dcfd0ad.e: The Muslims rejoiced greatly at his birth because the Jews had been saying: “We have bewitched them, so no child will be born to them.”

ece2310dcf.q: When did ʿAbd al-Malik ibn Marwan's caliphate become valid, according to al-Suyuti?
c: When Ibn al-Zubayr was killed in 73 AH
When he was pledged as his father's heir
ece2310dcf.e: ʿAbd al-Malik ruled by force until Ibn al-Zubayr was killed in 73 AH, and from that day his caliphate was valid.

05f04c4db9.q: Who demolished the Kaʿba and rebuilt it as it stands today, in 73 AH?
05f04c4db9.e: In the year 73 al-Hajjaj demolished the Kaʿba and rebuilt it as it is now.

1d146446c2.q: Why did ʿAbd al-Malik hesitate to put his son al-Walid over the Arabs, as Rawh ibn Zinbaʿ reported?
c: Because he did not know Arabic grammar well
1d146446c2.e: ʿAbd al-Malik said of al-Walid: “He does not know grammar well.” Al-Walid sat with the grammarians six months and came out more ignorant than before.

1361fed91a.q: Who was like a minister to Sulayman ibn ʿAbd al-Malik, who followed his advice in what was good?
1361fed91a.e: Among Sulayman's merits: ʿUmar ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAziz was like a minister to him, and he followed his advice in what was good.

e584b97af5.q: How did Sulayman ibn ʿAbd al-Malik open his caliphate, as Ibn Sirin said?
c: By restoring the prayer to its proper times
e584b97af5.e: Ibn Sirin said: may Allah have mercy on Sulayman; he opened his caliphate by restoring the prayer to its times and closed it by appointing ʿUmar ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAziz.

a310a74dfe.q: How many sworn witnesses did Hisham ibn ʿAbd al-Malik require before admitting money into his treasury?
a310a74dfe.e: Hisham was firm and wise; he admitted no money into his treasury until forty sworn witnesses had testified.

6daa51f2c9.q: How did Saʿid ibn al-Musayyib interpret ʿAbd al-Malik's dream that he urinated in the mihrab four times?
c: Four of his own sons will rule
Four of his sons will be killed
6daa51f2c9.e: Saʿid ibn al-Musayyib said: four of his own sons will rule - and the last of them was Hisham.

b5fbda8e54.q: Why was Yazid ibn al-Walid called “al-Naqis” (the Reducer)?
c: Because he reduced the soldiers' pay
Because his caliphate lasted under a year
Because he reduced the land tax
b5fbda8e54.e: Yazid ibn al-Walid was called al-Naqis because he reduced the soldiers' pay.

9b09ff834f.q: Who said: “I am the son of Khosrow, my father is Marwan … Caesar is my ancestor, and my ancestor the Khaqan”?
9b09ff834f.e: Yazid al-Naqis's mother was a daughter of the Persian kings, so he boasted: “I am the son of Khosrow, my father is Marwan…”

90fa22cf7c.q: What did Caliph al-Muntasir bi-llah return to the family of al-Husayn?
90fa22cf7c.e: Al-Muntasir was kind to the ʿAlids: he lifted the ban on visiting al-Husayn's grave and returned Fadak to the family of al-Husayn.

795274dfe2.q: What was al-Muʿtazz bi-llah the first caliph to introduce?
795274dfe2.e: Al-Muʿtazz was the first caliph to ride with gold trappings; the caliphs before him rode with light silver trappings.

e48371c71b.q: Which caliph did al-Suli say was, with ʿAli ibn Abi Talib, the only caliph named ʿAli?
e48371c71b.e: Al-Muktafi bi-llah Abu Muhammad ʿAli ibn al-Muʿtadid; al-Suli said: no caliph was named ʿAli except him and ʿAli ibn Abi Talib.

63e1092e3e.q: How did al-Suyuti describe Caliph al-Muhtadi bi-llah at the start of his biography?
63e1092e3e.e: Al-Suyuti described al-Muhtadi bi-llah as the righteous caliph; he was scrupulous, devout and just.

23715dbe1d.q: Who was the first to write dates from the Hijra?
23715dbe1d.e: Among ʿUmar's firsts: he was the first to write dates from the Hijra.

ef56ec6c50.q: Who was the first to establish a public treasury (bayt al-mal)?
ef56ec6c50.e: Among the firsts of ʿUmar, may Allah be pleased with him: he was the first to establish the public treasury.

179516e5d1.q: Who was the first to establish the night prayer of Ramadan in congregation?
179516e5d1.e: Among ʿUmar's firsts: he was the first to establish the night prayer of Ramadan.

ba0f2931fc.q: Who was the first to set up the register (diwan)?
ba0f2931fc.e: Among ʿUmar's firsts: he was the first to set up the register.

59abea67e1.q: Who was the first to patrol at night, checking on the people?
59abea67e1.e: Among ʿUmar's firsts: he was the first to patrol at night.

ca75a5c0ea.q: Who was the first to carry the whip (al-dirra), so that it was said: “ʿUmar's whip is more feared than your sword”?
ca75a5c0ea.e: Al-Nawawi said in his Tahdhib: he was the first to carry the dirra; Ibn Saʿd said the same.

0a7980d60a.q: Which garrison cities is ʿUmar said to have been the first to found?
c: Kufa, Basra, al-Jazira, Syria, Egypt and Mosul
0a7980d60a.e: Ibn Saʿd said: he was the first to appoint judges in the cities, and the first to found the garrison cities: Kufa, Basra, al-Jazira, Syria, Egypt and Mosul.

fc73583590.q: To whom did ʿUmar say “May Allah prolong your life,” being the first to say it?
fc73583590.e: Among ʿUmar's firsts according to al-ʿAskari: he was the first to say “May Allah prolong your life” - he said it to ʿAli.

ec1366cc01.q: Who was the first to apply ʿawl (proportional reduction) in inheritance shares?
ec1366cc01.e: Among ʿUmar's firsts: he was the first to apply ʿawl to the shares of inheritance.

8c0ebe6ea7.q: Who was the first to take zakat on horses?
8c0ebe6ea7.e: Among ʿUmar's firsts according to al-ʿAskari: he was the first to take zakat on horses.

c8caa294c0.q: What did Umm Ayman say on the day ʿUmar was killed?
c8caa294c0.e: Al-Tabarani narrated from Tariq ibn Shihab: Umm Ayman said on the day ʿUmar was killed: “Today Islam has been weakened.”

6d47f74095.q: Why did ʿUthman, may Allah be pleased with him, refuse to go out and fight those besieging him?
c: So as not to be the first to succeed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ by shedding blood in his Umma
Because he had no men with him
6d47f74095.e: ʿUthman said: “As for going out to fight, I will not be the first to succeed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in his Umma by shedding blood.”

c32ac01193.q: Why did ʿUthman refuse to go to Syria while he was besieged?
c: So as not to leave the land of his Hijra and the nearness of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ
Because the people of Syria did not like him
Because Muʿawiya refused to receive him
c32ac01193.e: ʿUthman said: “As for going to Syria, I will not leave the land of my Hijra and the nearness of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.”

c54d5a8ecd.q: In which month was ʿUthman, may Allah be pleased with him, killed?
c54d5a8ecd.e: ʿUthman was killed in the middle of the days of Tashriq in 35 AH; it is also said on Friday the 18th of Dhu al-Hijjah.

84c18b09b4.q: Where was ʿUthman, may Allah be pleased with him, buried?
84c18b09b4.e: ʿUthman was buried on Saturday night, between Maghrib and ʿIsha, in Hash Kawkab at al-Baqiʿ; he was the first buried there.

ca8b6bed70.q: What was ʿUthman's place in Islam, as he said while besieged?
ca8b6bed70.e: ʿUthman said while besieged: “I have stored up ten things with my Lord: I was the fourth of four in Islam…”

d04ff36c00.q: What was engraved on Abu Bakr al-Siddiq's ring?
d04ff36c00.e: Ibn Saʿd narrated from Hibban the goldsmith: the engraving on Abu Bakr's ring was “How excellent is Allah, the All-Able.”

560e693c26.q: Which four, father to son in one line, all lived to meet the Prophet ﷺ?
c: Abu Quhafa, Abu Bakr, ʿAbd al-Rahman and Abu ʿAtiq Muhammad
ʿAbd al-Muttalib, Abu Talib, ʿAli and al-Hasan
Al-Khattab, ʿUmar, ʿAbd Allah and Salim
ʿAffan, ʿUthman, ʿAbd Allah and Aban
560e693c26.e: Musa ibn ʿUqba said: we know of no four, with their sons, who met the Prophet ﷺ except Abu Quhafa, Abu Bakr, ʿAbd al-Rahman and Abu ʿAtiq.

1e2373ce5f.q: ʿAʾisha said: “No father of any of the Muhajirun became Muslim except the father of …”?
1e2373ce5f.e: ʿAʾisha, may Allah be pleased with her, said: no father of any of the Muhajirun became Muslim except the father of Abu Bakr.

3d72f97952.q: Whom did ʿUmar call out to while giving a sermon: “O Sariya, the mountain!”?
c: Sariya, the commander of his army
Sariya, the muezzin of the mosque
3d72f97952.e: ʿUmar sent an army under a man called Sariya, and while giving a sermon he began to call out: “O Sariya, the mountain!”

ca7cfdd7af.q: Why did Abu Bakr al-Siddiq narrate few hadiths, as al-Nawawi explains?
c: Because he died early, before the hadiths spread
Because he was busy with trade
ca7cfdd7af.e: The reason Abu Bakr narrated little is that he died early, before the hadiths spread and the Followers took care to hear them.

83f61a4eb3.q: Al-Suhayli mentions that the first to say “Bismika Allahumma” (In Your name, O Allah) was?
83f61a4eb3.e: Al-Suhayli mentions in al-Taʿrif wa-l-Iʿlam that Umayya ibn Abi al-Salt was the first to say “Bismika Allahumma.”

9e9c58a946.q: Al-Qamus was one of the forts of Khaybar. Whose was it?
9e9c58a946.e: Al-Qamus was the fort of Banu Abi al-Huqayq at Khaybar.

8d6d3c6b6a.q: Before the Battle of Muʾta, news reached the Muslims that Heraclius had camped at Maʾab in al-Balqaʾ - with how many Byzantines?
8d6d3c6b6a.e: Heraclius camped at Maʾab with a hundred thousand Byzantines, and as many Arabs joined him.

c8962bbed0.q: In which month and year was the Battle of Uhud?
c8962bbed0.e: Uhud was in Shawwal of the third year of the Hijra.

02250fe5d1.q: In which year of the Hijra was the Battle of Badr?
02250fe5d1.e: Badr was in Ramadan of the second year of the Hijra.

1eecf9f995.q: In which year of the Hijra was Makkah conquered?
1eecf9f995.e: Makkah was conquered in Ramadan of the year 8.

065dbec797.q: In which year of the Hijra did the Prophet ﷺ perform the Farewell Hajj?
065dbec797.e: The Prophet ﷺ performed the Farewell Hajj in the year 10 of the Hijra.

a7fcc458a0.q: According to Musa ibn ʿUqba from al-Zuhri, how many campaigns did the Prophet ﷺ lead in which there was no fighting?
a7fcc458a0.e: Al-Zuhri mentioned that he ﷺ led twelve campaigns in which there was no fighting.

0f438b5a7d.q: Where did most of the Jews of Banu al-Nadir go when the Prophet ﷺ expelled them from Madinah?
0f438b5a7d.e: Most of Banu al-Nadir went to Khaybar, among them Huyayy ibn Akhtab.

e0bfdc1d12.q: When did Abu Musa al-Ashʿari ﵁ come to the Prophet ﷺ?
c: The year of Khaybar, the year 7
e0bfdc1d12.e: Abu Musa al-Ashʿari arrived in the year of Khaybar, the seventh year of the Hijra.

c3ded13e96.q: After the Battle of Muʾta, al-Bukhari mentions an expedition of Usama ibn Zayd ﵄. Against whom was it?
c3ded13e96.e: The Prophet ﷺ sent Usama against al-Huruqat of Juhayna.

7b134eff7e.q: In which month was the Tabuk campaign?
7b134eff7e.e: The Tabuk campaign was in Rajab of the year 9.

a17825f915.q: What was the name of the Prophet's ﷺ son by Mariya the Copt?
a17825f915.e: Mariya bore the Prophet ﷺ Ibrahim, who died young.

fb046d80a6.q: ʿAmr ibn al-ʿAs ﵁ relates that he came to Madinah as a Muslim with a Companion who went ahead of him, became Muslim and pledged allegiance. Who was it?
fb046d80a6.e: Khalid ibn al-Walid and ʿAmr ibn al-ʿAs came together; Khalid went forward, became Muslim and pledged allegiance, then ʿAmr.

e88ed68dd8.q: Whom did Quraysh send to the Negus with gifts to have the emigrants returned to them?
c: ʿAmr ibn al-ʿAs and ʿUmara ibn al-Walid
ʿUtba and Shayba, sons of Rabiʿa
Abu Sufyan and Safwan ibn Umayya
e88ed68dd8.e: Quraysh sent ʿAmr ibn al-ʿAs and ʿUmara ibn al-Walid with gifts to the Negus.

2c977ed5c2.q: What was the name of the white mule among al-Muqawqis's gifts to the Prophet ﷺ?
2c977ed5c2.e: Among al-Muqawqis's gifts was a white mule named Duldul.

9d7a3e763b.q: Which Companion - a leader at ʿAqaba who fought at Badr - was killed as commander at Biʾr Maʿuna, and was called “he hastened to his death”?
9d7a3e763b.e: Al-Mundhir ibn ʿAmr, a leader at ʿAqaba who fought at Badr and Uhud, was killed as commander at Biʾr Maʿuna.
